home.processHeading: The Art of Pure Brass Foundry
home.processSubtitle: From raw molten alloy to hand-polished architectural hardware, witness the meticulous stages behind every piece created in our studio.

processSteps.title: Virgin Alloy Smelting
processSteps.description: We melt pure virgin copper and zinc alloys at 1,085°C to achieve supreme structural density and flawless surface purity.

processSteps.title: Precision Casting & Spinning
processSteps.description: Using traditional sand casting and heavy metal spinning lathes, raw forms are shaped to exact architectural blueprints.

processSteps.title: Hand Polishing & Knurling
processSteps.description: Master craftsmen use cotton buffing wheels and diamond knurling tools to achieve silk-smooth grain and tactile grip perfection.

processSteps.title: Patination & Quality Seal
processSteps.description: Hand-applied chemical patinas or micro-thin nano clear coats lock in color depth and protect against oxidation.

reviews.author: Archt. Kasun Jayawardena
reviews.comment: The tactile weight and precision knurling of Aurelia's door pulls completely transformed the main entry doors of our Cinnamon Gardens luxury villa project. Genuine 100% solid brass with no hollow compromise. Our clients were thoroughly impressed.

reviews.author: Ruwan & Dinithi Samarasinghe
reviews.comment: We ordered three spun brass dome lights for our coastal dining pavilion. The warm ambient glow is mesmerizing, and the anti-tarnish protective lacquer has held up impeccably despite the humid sea breeze.

reviews.author: Elena Rostova
reviews.comment: Exceptional craftsmanship. We specified 48 sets of Verona knurled handles for a boutique hotel kitchen and cabinetry suite. Every single piece had consistent patina depth and felt substantial in hand.

reviews.author: Dhanushka Perera
reviews.comment: Collaborating directly with Aurelia's foundry team on custom laser-cut screen partitions was seamless. They adhered to exact CAD tolerances and delivered two weeks ahead of schedule. Unmatched Sri Lankan metal artistry.

reviews.author: Maya Senanayake
reviews.comment: The Helios vessel is a true museum-quality centerpiece. The contrast between the organic sand-cast exterior and the mirror-polished bowl rim is breathtaking. Truly proud to support local master foundry artisans.

reviews.author: Chirantha Wickramasinghe
reviews.comment: We fitted the Olympus bridge faucets in our bar and open kitchen. Smooth ceramic disc valves and remarkable heavy brass build. It draws compliments from every guest.

about.heading: Four Decades of Master Metalworking & Pure Brass Innovation
about.subtitle: Founded in 1991, Aurelia Brass Co. has pioneered architectural brass fabrication, combining centuries-old sand casting techniques with precision engineering.
about.storyTitle: Born from Fire, Shaped by Hand
about.storyBody: What began as an independent foundry workshop in Colombo has evolved into an internationally acclaimed architectural metal studio. We reject hollow plated metals and cheap stampings, working exclusively in 100% solid virgin brass alloys.
about.sustainabilityBody: Brass is inherently 100% infinitely recyclable without any loss of structural integrity. 100% of our CNC brass shavings, casting gates, and trimmings are captured, re-smelted, and cast into new pieces.

faqs.q: What is the lead time for custom brass fabrication in Sri Lanka?
faqs.a: In-stock catalog items ship within 3–5 business days across Sri Lanka. Custom architectural fabrications typically take 2–4 weeks depending on CAD blueprint complexity, casting moulds, and hand-patination steps.

faqs.q: Do you offer trade pricing for local architects and interior designers?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer exclusive trade discounts (up to 25% off MSRP) for verified architects, interior designers, general contractors, and hotel developers. Please select 'Trade Program' in the form above.

faqs.q: What is the difference between living brass and lacquered brass?
faqs.a: Living brass (unlacquered) naturally oxidizes over time, developing a rich vintage patina suitable for coastal and tropical climates. Lacquered brass is coated with a clear baked-on protective layer that keeps the mirror gold lustre intact for decades.

faqs.q: Can you manufacture custom brass hardware from CAD blueprints?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Our foundry engineering team can import .DWG, .DXF, or .STEP files to precision CNC machine or sand-cast bespoke hardware to your exact architectural specifications.
